label: 58 · Encode Matrix
description: One render, many deliverables, no pipeline: `encodes` declares post-render transcode passes off a single workspace master. Codec, container and even size (as a stretching scale pass) — but never fps, duration or layout.

web.label: WebM (VP9)

mobile.label: Mobile (half size)
mobile.description: Add a half-size h264 encode. size on an encode is an ffmpeg scale pass: it STRETCHES, it does not re-lay out.

title.label: Title
title.description: Title on the card, so every deliverable is visibly the same render.
